A museum manages artifact loans in galleries. Each loan has a stable id, title, home gallery, medium from metal/paper/stone/textile, restricted boolean, optional reservation, notes, and immutable creation provenance {sequence,event_id,actor}. A reservation has gallery_id,slot,due,approval_id. A loan with no reservation is located at home. Galleries have stable id,name,department,slots,and an ordered list of ancestor rules. Rules have version,latest_due,and optionally allowed_media. Approval records have loan_id,gallery_id,until,exception (null or medium). Approvals are narrow and preissued; restricted loans require one. Approval must match loan and destination and cover due. An exception='medium' bypasses medium checks only, never dates. All ancestor latest_due limits apply, and due must be ISO date >=2026-10-30. Destination slot exists; at most one reserved loan occupies each gallery/slot. Names need not be unique; exact IDs are binding.

Typed operations (strict fields, no extras):
reserve: op,loan_id,gallery_id,slot,due,approval_id. Requires no prior reservation.
transfer: op,loan_id,to_gallery_id,slot,due,approval_id. Requires existing reservation.
cancel: op,loan_id. Requires reservation; removes it and returns location to home.
annotate: op,loan_id,text. Appends nonempty note <=500 characters.
create: op,loan_id,title,home,medium,restricted. Fresh authorized loan id; nonempty title <=200 characters; creates no reservation and empty notes, assigns next creation sequence with trusted event/actor.
Transaction has kind='transaction', context_id,tx_id,expected_revision,rule_versions,operations. One to twenty operations in order; all-or-nothing; end-state occupancy permits atomic swaps. Failed transactions mutate nothing. Repeated identical tx id is idempotent, different contents conflict. Alternative {kind:'clarify',question:string} mutates nothing.

The trusted host issues context: actor,scope (gallery ids),loan_ids,allowed_ops,event_id,referents,revision,rule_versions and opaque context_id. Both old and new locations/home on cancellation must be authorized neighborhoods, plus actor permissions. Permission to write is not approval. All rule ancestor versions and revision must match. Context is not writable by solver. Referents only explicit host bindings; otherwise resolve from visible evidence or clarify if ambiguous. Immutable creation provenance supports resolving 'item created in event X', not merely latest item. Reads are exact ids; query_records paginates creation sequences; occupancy exposes hidden occupant as occupied without identity; search returns candidates not binding. Scoped lookup and neighborhood indexes remain external persistent state.
